predictions.rationale: Primary API controller exposing endpoints to manage and retrieve catalog items, brands, types and pictures.
Core domain model representing catalog items including description, price, picture and stock.
Entity Framework DbContext defining CatalogItem, CatalogBrand and CatalogType sets and data access.
MVC front-end service calling catalog API to obtain catalog items and related data shown in storefront.
Web UI controller orchestrating catalog page display, interacting with CatalogService and view models.
gRPC implementation providing catalog operations to other microservices and clients.
Seeds initial catalog brands, types, items and pictures into the database.
Entity Framework mapping configuration for CatalogItem including table schema and relationships.
View model used by MVC views to render catalog items and associated information in storefront.
Helper extension methods for manipulating or projecting CatalogItem data for API responses.
